name: WF-EC-01
description: Workflow pornit de Manual Trigger sau Chat Trigger care trimit datele spre un nod Code JavaScript ce adauga un timestamp pe fiecare item.

nodes.name: EC_Validate_Input
nodes.notes:
VALIDATE INPUT NODE — v1.0
Validates required UUIDs (tenant_id, thread_id, trigger_message_id) with a permissive UUID regex.
Derives deterministic idempotency_key if absent: '<tenant_id>:<trigger_message_id>:exec_ctx:v1'.
Outputs _valid='true'|'false' as STRING (safe for switch v2/v3).
Non-UUID tenant_id/thread_id/trigger_message_id → INVALID_UUID.
Unparseable resolved_at → INVALID_RESOLVED_AT.
Oversized idempotency_key (>300) → IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LONG.

nodes.name: EC_Route_Valid
nodes.notes:
ROUTE VALID NODE
_valid is STRING 'true'/'false' — safe for switch v2 dataType=boolean with value1 coerced.
Output 0: valid → EC_Build_Init_Payload
Output 1: invalid → EC_Return_Error

nodes.name: EC_Build_Init_Payload
nodes.notes:
BUILD INIT PAYLOAD NODE — v1.0
Materializes the exact row to be upserted.
ALL fields align with live public.execution_contexts schema.
expires_at = NOW() + 15 minutes; can be made tenant-configurable later.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO execution_contexts (tenant_id, thread_id, trigger_message_id, status, pending_steps, completed_steps, idempotency_key, expires_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7, $8::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, tenant_id, thread_id, trigger_message_id, status, current_goal, current_plan_ref, pending_steps, completed_steps, idempotency_key, expires_at, created_at, updated_at

nodes.name: EC_Upsert_Context
nodes.notes:
UPSERT CONTEXT NODE — v1.0
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING *.
alwaysOutputData MUST be set true so downstream EC_Load_Existing_Context always fires,
including the replay case where 0 rows are returned.
Parameters bound via queryReplacement ($1..$8).
Alignment: ALL column names match live schema.
Fallback on CONFLICT handled by EC_Load_Existing_Context (idempotent read).

parameters.query: SELECT id, tenant_id, thread_id, trigger_message_id, status, current_goal, current_plan_ref, pending_steps, completed_steps, idempotency_key, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM execution_contexts WHERE idempotency_key = $1 AND tenant_id = $2::uuid LIMIT 1

nodes.name: EC_Load_Existing_Context
nodes.notes:
LOAD EXISTING CONTEXT NODE — v1.0
Deterministic idempotent read by (idempotency_key, tenant_id).
Cross-tenant safety: tenant_id is part of the WHERE clause even though idempotency_key is globally unique.
This ensures both fresh-insert and replay paths return the canonical row.
alwaysOutputData = true so downstream EC_Return_Result can classify 0-row as INTERNAL_LOAD_FAILED.

nodes.name: EC_Return_Result
nodes.notes:
RETURN RESULT NODE — v1.0
Maps the loaded DB row to the canonical ExecutionContext output contract.
Source-of-truth binding: $('EC_Load_Existing_Context') (NOT the upsert output) so that
replay and fresh-insert paths return an identical shape.

nodes.name: EC_Return_Error
nodes.notes:
RETURN ERROR NODE — v1.0
Returns a schema-compatible shape with error classification.
Never writes to DB.
